Chapter 30

Chapter 30: Song Jiaxin: We Meet Again

Lin Fan looked at the blackboard, which had no more space to write on. He put down the chalk in his hand and said, “The Twin Prime Number Conjecture is a huge project that needs to be carefully studied and explored.

“Let’s end it here for today.”

Hu Tian nodded in agreement and said, “Can we exchange contact information? It’ll make it easier for us to discuss at any time.”

“Of course, we can,” Lin Fan replied.

Then, the two of them took out their phones and added each other’s WeChat and mobile numbers.

Ring!

It was at this time that the bell that marked the end of class rang.

Hu Tian slowly left the classroom.

All the students’ eyes were fixed on the podium and on Lin Fan.

Their eyes were red.

One lesson! An entire lesson!

Hu Tian and Lin Fan stood together and discussed the problem for an entire lesson!

In the end, they even added each other’s WeChat and mobile numbers.

Hu Tian’s WeChat and mobile number!

Envy! Jealousy!

If looks could kill, Lin Fan’s heart would have been pierced by a thousand arrows and he would have been cut into pieces!

Lin Fan touched his nose and returned to his seat.

“Teacher Tiantian! Teacher Tiantian actually took the initiative to add Brother Fan as a friend on WeChat. Oh my God!” Song Yi shouted to the sky.

“I know I won’t have the chance to add Teacher Tiantian on WeChat, but Brother Fan, please let me see Teacher Tiantian’s Moments. I hope that my wish in this life will be fulfilled!” After Zheng Jinbao finished speaking, he immediately hugged Lin Fan’s thigh.

Lin Fan did not know whether to laugh or cry when he saw how the two of them were acting.

“Brother Fan, can you teach me how to calculate this?” After Ma Zhong said this, he could not help but blush.

Yesterday, he had told him that if he had any questions, he could ask him at any time.

In the end, he had to ask Lin Fan instead.

In this regard, he was stunned.

Lin Fan was not too bothered.

He easily answered Ma Zhong’s question and then sent Zheng Jinbao and Song Yi away.

At this point, his ears finally regained their peace.

At this moment, a faint fragrance drifted over.

Then, a beautiful figure appeared beside him.

Her facial features were sweet, her skin was smooth, and her black hair fell naturally on her slender shoulders.

She was as gentle as water, quiet, and elegant.

“Lin Fan, we meet again. My name is Song Jiaxin.”

As song Jiaxin spoke, she took the initiative to stretch out her slender hand.

‘We meet again?’

Lin Fan secretly used his Eyes of Truth to observe Song Jiaxin.

[Appearance: 95]

[Favorability: 60]

Another great beauty!

In addition, his favorability had reached 60. This Song Jiaxin seemed to have a good impression of him?

However, he did not know her at all.

Even though he was suspicious, Lin Fan still extended his hand and said, “Hello, have we met before?”

“A few days ago, you drove a Lamborghini and easily overtook my Ferrari on the highway,” Song Jiaxin said.

When Lin Fan heard that, he suddenly remembered and said, “So, it’s you.”

That day, after Lin Fan found out that his father, Lin Tao, was seriously ill, he wanted to return to Qing City in the shortest time possible.

Thus, he drove at the fastest speed he could.

On the way, he saw a Ferrari driving at high speed.

However, Lin Fan did not pay attention to the driver of the Ferrari.

Song Jiaxin said, “You remember. I rarely see someone of my age with such good skills. Could you add me on WeChat?”

“Of course,” Lin Fan said.

Beep!

With a light ring, the two successfully added each other as friends.

“Alright, let’s talk again when we’re free,” Song Jiaxin said.

After speaking, Song Jiaxin turned around and left.

At the side, Song Yi, Zheng Jinbao, and Ma Zhong had their mouths in an ‘O’ shape. They slowly closed their mouths.

“Brother Fan, can you let me see Song Jiaxin’s Moments?” Zheng Jinbao said in a daze.

Song Yi looked up and shouted, “Heavens!” First, it was the beautiful twin girls who added Brother Fan on WeChat. Then, it was Teacher Tiantian who added Brother Fan on WeChat. Now, even the ice queen Song Jiaxin has added Brother Fan on WeChat!

“Brother Fan, you’re my brother!”

“Brother Fan, you’re really too amazing,” Ma Zhong said in a daze.

Lin Fan only laughed in response to their lamentations.

…

Female dormitory, Room 502.

The beautiful twin girls stared at Lin Fan’s WeChat without blinking.

After a long time, they opened the dialog box.

They continued to type the message they had edited yesterday.

Red: [Hey, are you asleep? Thank you for stopping the basketball and saving me. The moon is so round today. Did you see it? I didn’t see you play basketball today. Will you play tomorrow?]

Blue: [Hi, are you asleep? Thank you for stopping the basketball and saving me. The moon is so round today. Did you see it? I didn’t see you play basketball today. Will you play tomorrow?]

Then, the two of them stretched out their slender fingers, wanting to click ‘send’.

However, just as they were about to touch the screen, they stopped simultaneously and could not press it.

…

For the next two days, Lin Fan was extremely relaxed and satisfied.

The red packets he received at 12 o’clock every day were all cash. In addition to the cash he earned from walking, sleeping, and breathing, Lin Fan’s funds had already reached 15 million.

On this day, Lin Fan had just finished class and was walking back to his dormitory.

Ring!

The phone in his pocket vibrated slightly.

Lin Fan casually looked at his phone. It was a WeChat message from Song Jiaxin.

Song Jiaxin: [There’s a car race tonight. Are you interested in joining us?]

Lin Fan had nothing to do at night anyway.

Then, he thought of the satisfying feeling of racing.

Hence, he replied to the message.

[Alright.]

…

It was nine o’clock in the evening. The night was as dark as ink. There was only a crescent moon hanging in the sky like a boat.

Song Jiaxin sat in the front passenger seat of the Lamborghini and asked, “Your car doesn’t seem to have undergone any modifications.”

“Yeah,” Lin Fan nodded.

“Then how did you go so fast a few days ago?” Song Jiaxin said.

“Maybe because it has 700 horsepower?” Lin Fan said.

Song Jiaxin choked.

Of course, she knew that the Lamborghini had 700 horsepower, but without a modified tail, custom-made wheels, and engine adjustments, its speed would only be that.

At this moment, at the foot of East Mountain Road, more than a dozen cool sports cars had gathered.

Nearly 20 young and beautiful men and women were gathered together.

They were all well-known rich second generations in Jiangbei.

Boom!

Finally, Lin Fan’s Lamborghini stopped behind them.

When some people saw Song Jiaxin, they all greeted her.

“It’s Sister Jiaxin!”

“Big Sister Jiaxin, did you change your car?”

“No, this is my friend, Lin Fan’s, car.” Song Jiaxin shook her head.

“Lin Fan?”

Only then did the crowd start to size Lin Fan up.

A man in an Armani shirt said, “Sis Jiaxin, he can’t be your boyfriend, right?”

“We’re classmates,” Song Jiaxin replied.

Boom!

Boom!

At this moment, a beast-like roar came from the distance.

Then, a black Lamborghini and a royal blue McLaren P1 drove past them together.

Finally, they stopped firmly in front of everyone.

“It’s Liu Yuhang and Sun Luguo!”

“The two of them have been fighting for years, right? I didn’t expect the smell of gunpowder to be so strong right as they showed up.”

“After all, Liu Pharmaceuticals and Sun Pharmaceuticals have been fighting for decades. They can be considered enemies.”

The crowd whispered and discussed.

Lin Fan’s expression changed slightly.

For the past few days, Lin Fan had been thinking of all sorts of ways to get his hands on the hundred-year-old ginseng and the hundred-year-old spirit branch.

Liu Pharmaceuticals and Sun Pharmaceuticals were both well-known pharmaceutical companies in Jiang province.

There might be some hope in getting those things through them.
